label: PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_2: composite-restricted identity on a fixed partial order
paraphrase: OPEN analyst principle on the SAME supplied Type B with the SAME supplied PartialOrder B: for all x and y in B, if both have a strict proper part and have equal strict proper-part profiles, then x=y. Only the two compared objects are restricted to composites; parts still range over all B. It asserts no composites exist. Weak sibling of unrestricted proper-part extensionality; it neither asserts nor requires the strong sibling.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Interpret the same selected bearer and its constitutive principles in an explicit partial order. Show when its matter/form or real esse/essence distinction gives a proper subobject and when order-composition agrees with the q.3 a.7 Composite predicate.
connection_plan.blocker: Strict lower cones contain individuals of the ordered carrier. The typed q.3 composition can compare principles in a separate sort without supplying proper subobjects. Extensional identity of order composites alone says nothing about what constitutes the bearer; simple priority and cause of esse would require separate premises even after calibration.
